"""Generate and verify a replayable placement attempt for the frozen roll_up_ball scene."""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_robowits import Session

OUT = '/app/output/trajectory.npz'
s = Session('roll_up_ball', instance='/app/instance.json')
s.reset()
p = s.primitives()
print('initial', s.status(), flush=True)
print('initial box', s.objects()['box'], flush=True)
# The box is aligned at yaw 0.302 rad. Approach vertically and close across its x axis.
yaw = 0.301668
q = p['top_down_quat'](yaw)
s.record_start()
p['open_gripper']('left', steps=12)
p['move_ee']('left', (0.668, 0.095, 0.96), q, linear=5)
p['move_ee']('left', (0.668, 0.095, 0.808), q, linear=3)
p['close_gripper']('left', steps=24)
p['hold'](20)
print('after close', s.objects()['box']['position'], flush=True)
p['move_ee']('left', (0.668, 0.095, 0.97), q, linear=4)
p['hold'](15)
print('after lift', s.objects()['box']['position'], flush=True)
# Carry above the rim, then lower to the basket floor height and release.
p['move_ee']('left', (0.355, 0.005, 0.97), q, linear=8)
p['move_ee']('left', (0.355, 0.005, 0.82), q, linear=4)
p['open_gripper']('left', steps=20)
p['hold'](180)
print('placed box', s.objects()['box'], flush=True)
print('attempt status', s.status(), flush=True)
actions = s.record_stop()
# Re-run from the frozen snapshot and save exactly the open-loop actions checked here.
replay = s.replay(actions)
print('replay status', replay, 'actions', actions.shape, flush=True)
s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={'method': 'left-arm top-down grasp and basket placement', 'expected_success': replay['success']})
print('saved', OUT, flush=True)
PY
